purpose: Research-governance risk budget for a conditional allocation. It is not a suitability finding, execution authorization, stop-loss promise, or forecast.

current_state.reason: No finite cross-asset decision universe, candidate-level eligibility packets, account-level drawdown record or approved portfolio risk budget.

defensive_diversifier.rule: An undefined sleeve may not receive a generic stress input or offset the known-sleeve loss.

planning_common_stress.conclusion: The retired fixed vector does not fit the current -18% loss-action envelope. No future portfolio may activate until a frozen T2 candidate set has a dated, candidate-specific risk budget.

exception_must_include: frozen-T2 common-stress calculation including every proposed direct equity, ETF, REIT, sovereign/cash tool and implementation-cost uncertainty
approved planning-loss capacity at least equal to the calculated loss plus a documented uncertainty buffer
documented investment-horizon, liquidity-need and loss-capacity confirmation
independent product, liquidity, concentration, correlation, tax and settlement passes
record that the -18% line is an early risk-action boundary rather than a maximum-loss representation

observed_drawdown_actions.measurement: DD_t = flow-adjusted current marked account value / flow-adjusted high-water mark - 1; a dated account-value record is required.
observed_drawdown_actions.caution_action: Pause all new risk additions pending re-underwriting. Any cash disposition remains investor-directed and separately recorded.
observed_drawdown_actions.risk_stop_action: Set the global risk-addition gate to zero, cancel unexecuted model tranches, and require an incident/de-risk proposal before any later re-approval. Any cash disposition remains investor-directed and separately recorded.
observed_drawdown_actions.stress_capacity_incident: If an approved exception exists and observed loss reaches 90% of that approved planning-loss capacity, the risk stop remains in force and a replacement risk budget is required. No mechanical re-entry is allowed.
observed_drawdown_actions.boundary: These are governance actions for new allocations, not instructions to sell existing holdings and not promises that loss will stop at a threshold.

candidate_specific_concentration_policy.future_T4_requirement: Freeze the named T2 set, calculate issuer/group/industry/factor/property/rental/customer/financing/rate overlap and propose numerical concentration and liquidity limits for independent risk approval.

reit_independence_controls.pairwise_correlation_rule: A pair with verified rolling-60-observation return correlation greater than 0.70 is one risk cluster; combined exposure must stay within the 10% cluster cap.
reit_independence_controls.missing_or_unreliable_history_rule: Missing, inadequate or structurally unreliable price history cannot prove independence and requires a qualitative common-driver review; unresolved result is q_0.
reit_independence_controls.cross_sleeve_requirement: Map dividend-ETF and REIT common sponsor, issuer group, property/rental, regulated revenue, customer and financing exposures before activation.

total_return_objective_policy.measurement: Rolling-five-year annualized, cost-aware TWRR; MWRR/XIRR is separately reported when external flows exist.
total_return_objective_policy.objective_outcome_action: Record the outcome and refresh return evidence; do not use leverage, asset sales, lower credit quality, a forced REIT fill or higher concentration to repair it.
total_return_objective_policy.two_consecutive_review_period_outcomes_a: Freeze all proposals to raise market-risk exposure until the full cross-asset risk-budget, total-return evidence, tax, liquidity and concentration review is rerun.
total_return_objective_policy.cash_boundary: Cash distributions are reconciled as components of total return. They are not a separate target, risk budget, annual success/failure status, or reason to change risk exposure.

warnings: The planning-stress inputs are not historical estimates, probabilities, VaR, maximum losses or return forecasts.
A cash receipt is part of total return and cannot be counted as an additional return after a later cash-use choice.
An issuer-labelled or economically similar capital-repayment component requires a separate ledger flag and predeclared treatment; it is not labelled investment return or counted twice.
No value in this file proves that any current product, REIT candidate or account is eligible.
